text: Your PVC has been selected for revalidation. Submit your voter ID and bank verification number at http://pvc-revalidate.example/secure within 6 hours or your registration will be cancelled.
note: Credential and identity harvest with a 6-hour threat.

text: Dear Presiding Officer, the collation portal requires an emergency password reset. Reply with your current password and OTP so the ICT desk can restore your access before 6pm.
note: No URL at all; password and OTP request by reply.

text: Congratulations! You are entitled to N25,000 election duty allowance. Pay a N2,000 processing fee to account 0123456789 and send the receipt to the coordinator.
note: Advance-fee lure without a link.

text: Breaking results: the final figures for your ward have been uploaded early. Download the leaked sheet at https://ward-results.example/leak and share widely before it is deleted.
note: Leaked-results disinformation with a pull to share.

text: Gaisuwa, kalmar sirrin ku ta kare. Sake shigar da imel da kalmar sirri a https://inec-session.example/login don ci gaba da shiga dashboard.
note: Hausa credential harvest not copied from the training templates.

text: Please open the attached updated voters register.xlsm and click Enable Macros to synchronise your ward data. This is mandatory before collation.
note: Macro-enabled attachment instruction.

text: This is the Chairman's security aide. We are auditing the result server tonight. Send the admin PIN and server address to my private number immediately.
note: Authority impersonation and secrecy; no link.

text: Your accreditation badge is ready. Confirm your full name, date of birth, passport number and BVN at https://accreditation-check.example/verify to collect it.
note: Sensitive identity fields on a lookalike domain.

text: The commission has shortlisted you for a foreign observation mission. Pay the visa processing fee of N15,000 at https://observer-visa.example/pay today.
note: Opportunity lure with an upfront fee.

text: URGENT: all staff must re-verify their accounts at http://bit.example/inec-verify or lose system access within 12 hours.
note: Shortener-style URL, plain HTTP and a loss threat.

text: Vote buying has been detected at your polling unit. To clear your name, send your voter number and a selfie at https://clear-name.example/verify.
note: Accusation pressure used to harvest identity data.

text: Aka sanar da ku cewa an zabi ku don aikin sa ido. Biya N5,000 a https://observer-tag.example/pay kafin gobe.
note: Hausa payment request for a fake observer tag.

text: Security advisory: our ICT team will never ask for your password or one-time code. Report any message that requests them to security@inec.gov.ng or your local office.
note: Benign message that contains password vocabulary.

text: The commission will hold a free refresher training for presiding officers in Lagos on 14 November 2027. Register through your supervisor. No payment is required.
note: Benign logistics notice with a future date.

text: Voters can confirm their polling unit at https://inec.gov.ng/ or at the local government office. Voter registration and card collection are free.
note: Official domain and explicit no-fee wording.

text: Official notice: results are announced only by the returning officer at the collation centre. Ignore screenshots from unverified social media accounts.
note: Benign guidance that mentions result rumours.

text: A media briefing will hold at the State Electoral Office on 20 November 2027. Accreditation for approved outlets is free. Read the statement at https://inec.gov.ng/news/.
note: Uses the word accreditation but states it is free.

text: Sanarwa: karbi katin zabe a ofishin da kuka yi rajista. Karba kyauta ce kuma ba a bukatar biya.
note: Hausa public notice stating collection is free.

text: If you receive a message asking you to pay for accreditation, do not pay. Verify it with your supervisor or at https://cert.gov.ng/report/.
note: Anti-fraud advisory phrased as an instruction.

text: The observers' briefing will start at 8:00am at the National Situation Room. Bring your accreditation badge and a valid ID.
note: Briefing logistics with ordinary operational language.

text: Please submit your observation checklist through the official portal https://inec.gov.ng/contact/ after the exercise. Do not share credentials.
note: Benign instruction plus a security reminder.

text: The commission denies reports of a portal shutdown. Official updates are published at https://inec.gov.ng/news/.
note: Denial of a rumour on an official domain.

text: Journalists should verify claims with the press office before publication. The official FAQ is at https://nccc.gov.ng/.
note: Short official guidance.

text: Your password reset request was received. For your security, no password was changed. Contact the internal ICT help desk if you did not request this.
note: Routine reset notification with password vocabulary.

text: A public holiday has been declared for the election date. Normal office hours resume the following Monday. No fee is required for any electoral service.
note: Administrative notice with a fee disclaimer.

text: The collation centre will publish updates at https://inec.gov.ng/contact/. Compare any figure against the signed result sheet.
note: Benign verification guidance with a result vocabulary.

text: Hello colleague, kindly confirm your staff ID and portal password by replying to this message. This is for the annual access review. Do not use the public portal.
note: Low-urgency request for credentials with a secrecy instruction.

text: The results portal now supports direct uploads. Use the new link http://results-upload.example/login with your existing credentials to synchronise ward sheets.
note: Plausible administrative pretext on a lookalike domain.
